Wife Arrested for Alleged Plot with Gang to Extort Husband

Delhi Police's Special Cell has arrested a businessman's wife and an associate of the Gogi gang for allegedly plotting to extort 50 lakh rupees from her husband. The conspiracy reportedly involved threats of violence against the businessman and his children. The investigation revealed the wife as the alleged mastermind behind the scheme.
